look_here_first: Find a tall riparian cottonwood with alternate, broadly ovate to heart-shaped finely serrated leaves (spring leaves may look narrower), sticky reddish-brown aromatic winter buds, and pale whitish leaf undersides. Confirm long hanging catkins, cottony seed capsules and twig/bud characters; separate from local Populus deltoides using blade shape, undersides, petiole and fine margin teeth.
